preconditions.description: The number of queries is between 1 and 10, inclusive.
The number of nodes is between 2 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of edges is between 1 and n * (n - 1) / 2, inclusive.
Each node number is between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The result array length is n - 1, representing distances to nodes in increasing node number order, not including the start node.
Each distance in the result is either -1 (if the node is unreachable) or a non-negative integer representing the shortest distance from the start node.
The distance to the start node itself is 0.

invariants.description: Nodes not reachable from the start node have a distance of -1.
